module.summary: RTT-Inside drift-bounded structural report for ERCOT San Antonio cluster — a stable enterprise and cloud hub anchored by Microsoft, with growing cloud presence and solid grid adjacency.

ai.module.description: Cluster-level module manifest for ERCOT San Antonio. Covers 7 facilities including Microsoft cloud campuses, regional enterprise compute, telecom edge fiber, and energy-adjacent industrial compute. Includes RTT operator scores, drift/coherence envelopes, facility list, and navigation pointers.

cluster_mapping.cluster.name: San Antonio
cluster_mapping.cluster.notes: Stable grid adjacency; growing cloud presence; Microsoft-anchored enterprise workloads; moderate expansion trajectory.
